status: RECONCILIATION EVIDENCE + PROPOSAL (0 code changes, 0 database changes, 0 paid generations)
mature_endpoint: IDEA → BUSINESS UNDERSTANDING → IDENTITY → OFFER → CUSTOMER JOURNEY → DIGITAL LOCATION/WORLD → PRODUCT SYSTEM → MARKETING SYSTEM → LIVE OPERATIONS → MEASUREMENT → MAINTENANCE → EVOLUTION (+ PLATFORM_FOUNDATION, which cuts across every stage)
reading: For each stage: what SITE 00 has (EXISTS_*), what it only thinks it has (CONCEPT_ONLY / DUPLICATED_COMPETING), and what is missing. verdict_today is the one-line reconciliation.
